finding: INV-4 is VACUOUS on the exact path that produced the reported bug. clamp_thinking_budget is applied only inside the style=="budget" arm, but family_thinking_style never returns "budget" (only "adaptive", param_policy.rs:207-226), and providers/openai.rs never reads budget_tokens at all — it emits reasoning_effort. So on the OpenAI-compatible Qwen path there is no thinking budget to clamp and no bound whatsoever. Verified by orchestrator: grep for budget_tokens in providers/openai.rs returns nothing.

A mid-stream provider ERROR persists completion_state='empty'. Both Err arms call finalize() with cancelled=false and finish_reason=None, so classify_completion_state(None,false,false) returns Empty, whose copy is 'The model returned an empty response... Please try again.' — the exact string this change exists to eliminate, now asserted confidently for a turn that actually errored. Violates INV-3 (must name the ACTUAL cause). Verified by orchestrator at streaming.rs:598-624.

content_filter / refusal are classified Empty and therefore told 'Please try again', although an identical retry reproduces them deterministically — precisely what INV-3 refuses. Worse, a unit test at streaming.rs:3148 explicitly asserts classify_completion_state(Some("content_filter"),false,false)==Empty, i.e. a test CERTIFYING the invariant violation. Root cause is the catch-all _ => Empty, which turns 'a reason I did not enumerate' into the positive claim 'the model had nothing to say'. Verified by orchestrator.

CompletionState::Aborted — the largest single cause class (315 of 680 measured notices) — is exercised ONLY by the pure classifier unit test. No integration or e2e test cancels a real turn and re-reads the message, so the single line of real wiring (acc.cancelled = true) is never executed by any test. The wiring also has a reachable miss: it fires only when tx.send fails, which requires ANOTHER chunk after the receiver drops; if the drop is first seen on the terminal chunk, process_chunk has already finalized with cancelled=false.

Reachable NEW paths end answerless with completion_state NULL and fall back to the generic 'empty response ... try again' copy, asserting a cause they do not know: (a) chat_stream() returning Err before any accumulator exists (429/5xx/context-length-exceeded), (b) BeforeLlmAction::Complete short-circuit, (c) the agent-core loop, which hardcodes completion_state: None. The frontend 'unknown' branch should say it does not know rather than name a cause.

budget_tokens.unwrap_or(10000).max(1024) re-raises a clamped budget ABOVE a small completion budget (completion 1000 -> clamp 500 -> adapter 1024), violating INV-4 on the wire. The clamp test asserts the property on the pure function only, so it stays green while the invariant breaks two layers down.

INV-2's reload half is only partly implemented: the provider finish_reason itself is never persisted, only a lossy derived classification that exists solely for answerless turns. A turn that streamed a PARTIAL answer and ended 'length' records NULL, so after reload there is no trace it was truncated (silently amputated answer) — and a passing test certifies that loss as correct.
The 'aborted' copy names the cause but no action, while INV-3 requires cause AND an action the user can take.
Stale docstring still documents the removed finish_reason:"empty" telemetry signal and references backend tests renamed in this same diff.
